title: NewsSearchRecent
description: NEWS-LOOK-02. One search a person ran in the News app, kept so the Search page can offer it again. Person scope: never readable by another person or an admin page. Never created for a child: a child's search keeps no recents. The schema carries no age band, so that rule cannot be enforced here; `validateNewsSearchRecent` in spec/records/ts/validate.ts takes the owner's band from the caller and rejects a child's row, and the hub writes through it.
